text.p: The Navigation Bar Settings will allow you to customize which icons will show up in the navigation bar, and also the sort order.

ul.li: Sort by activated time - In this mode the sort order is the time spent with each view open.
Sort by number of activations - In this mode the sort order is the number of times a views has been opened, including times it is opened by setting/changing layout.
Custom order - In this mode it is possible to change the order of the icons, where the first ones are on top.

text.note: Even if using Custom order, views that are part of a group will be shown in the extended menu.
